tool.name: ChartVPS
tool.description: ChartVPS sells managed trading servers, including CPU plans and GPU plans aimed at order-flow charts. Locations include Chicago, New York, London, Frankfurt, Singapore, Tokyo, Dallas and Hong Kong.
features: CPU VPS on AMD Ryzen, plus NVIDIA GPU plans
Aimed at NinjaTrader, MetaTrader, MultiCharts, TradeStation, cTrader and thinkorswim
Daily snapshots and DDoS protection included, according to the homepage
Chicago latency to CME described as 0 to 1 ms typical

plans.name: Alpha series
plans.detail: CPU VPS. Example spec: 2 cores, 4 GB RAM, 128 GB NVMe.

plans.name: Gamma series
plans.detail: GPU-assisted VPS. Example spec: 3 cores, 10 GB RAM, 250 GB NVMe, NVIDIA L4.

plans.name: Delta series
plans.detail: Dedicated server. Example spec: 16 cores, 128 GB RAM, 2 TB-class NVMe.

tool.pricing_note: Starting prices from the official homepage on 11 Oct 2026. Higher specs inside each series cost more.
